title: Google and the Kubernetes community announce Agent Sandbox for gVisor-isolated agent code execution
summary: On 11 November 2025, at KubeCon NA 2025, Google Cloud introduced Agent Sandbox, a new Kubernetes primitive built with the Kubernetes community for agent code execution and computer use: it is built on gVisor with additional support for Kata Containers, is being developed as a CNCF project, is available in open source and deployable on GKE, and ships a Python SDK that wraps sandbox creation in a context manager. On GKE it uses managed gVisor in GKE Sandbox and administrator-configured pre-warmed sandbox pools for sub-second start, up to a 90% improvement over cold starts, and the companion GKE-exclusive Pod Snapshots feature for checkpoint and restore of running pods is in limited preview.
verification_note: URL fetched 2026-10-17; page dated November 11, 2025 (Google Cloud Blog, Brandon Royal).
